"After sealing the evil god Calasmos in the
  sky, I founded Zwaardsrust to rebuild
  the ravaged world.

"Under my rule the kingdom flourished,
  and people came to call me the great
  founder, King Neresen...

"There seems to be someone among you
  with ties to Zwaardsrust.

"That face... That you became a Luminary's
  companion like me may be fate,
  not chance.

"...Lord Neresen, you fought beside the
  legendary Luminary long ago.
  Why are you still in a place like this?

"At my death, I built this labyrinth with the
  Watchers for the day the evil god might
  return, and hid powerful arms here.

"To aid the Luminary, I became
  a mere soul and awaited you here.

"...You are the heir to the Luminary's name.
  Indeed, you have Erdwin's eyes.

"This labyrinth was itself a trial for the
  Luminary. You overcame it well.
  I shall grant you one wish.

"...But only if you overcome
  my final trial!

"In this trial, the greatest enemy that
  threatens you, the fear within you,
  takes form and stands in your way.

"But if you overcome it, you will gain
  strength that no foe can defeat.

"Now, Luminary. Speak to me
  when you wish to take the trial.
